title: 📊 Daily Report: Wed Nov 25, 2026
text:

Published code is 20261125-1613-e3bb75eab018 and the desktop is still on 20261123-1759-ae649894eae9 (staged tests failed). Host flags: reboot pending, task has no startup trigger. Parity check: book identical, no input or config drift. Freeze cost today: box -54.58 vs desktop -54.60 (-0.02); running total -8.25 over 5 days. Tonight's re-seed was pushed (seed-2026-11-25-175620, valid until Fri Nov 27 9:25 AM ET).

Engine timing: first tick 9:31 AM, and a tick landed 3:48 PM, both fine. The 10:30 swing scan ran about 6 minutes late (box freeze), which delayed Rota's shadow fill. The 1:00 scan came after a gap ending 1:04 PM, within tolerance. No CORE skips today.

Claude impact: no new advice today. The stops-review fixes (batch b20261125-014349) are in progress with stops OFF and are not published.
